description: The container path source the ECS/Fargate service runs: a minimal Python 3.12 web app and its Dockerfile. The ECS service and taskdef are already defined (FEAT-001 stack, FEAT-002 taskdef); this provides the actual image source. Independent of FEAT-004/005.
steps: Create <ROOT>/container/app.py: a tiny HTTP service (stdlib http.server, no external deps) exposing GET / (health 'ok') and a POST/GET /order endpoint that echoes an order with loyalty points, listening on a configurable PORT env (default 8080).
Create <ROOT>/container/requirements.txt (empty or pinned if a tiny framework is chosen; prefer stdlib-only so no deps).
Create <ROOT>/container/Dockerfile: FROM python:3.12-slim, copy app.py, EXPOSE 8080, CMD runs app.py. No build step requiring network at verification time.
acceptance_criteria: container/app.py compiles (python3 -c compile) and defines an HTTP handler with a health route
Dockerfile uses python:3.12-slim and exposes the service port
No external pip dependencies required to run (stdlib-only), keeping the image small
findings:
Container image source implemented and verified LOCAL-ONLY (no docker build/push). Verification: CONTAINER_APP_COMPILES, DOCKERFILE_BASE_OK (python:3.12-slim), PORT_EXPOSED_OK. Smoke-tested the stdlib http.server app end-to-end: GET / -> 200 {"status":"ok"}; GET /order -> 200 sample order; POST /order with JSON body -> 200 with loyalty points; malformed POST body -> 400.

EXPOSED PORT: 8080 (configurable via PORT env, default 8080). Consistent with FEAT-001 ECS service containerPort 8080 / ALB target and FEAT-002 taskdef.json portMappings containerPort 8080. Dockerfile sets ENV PORT=8080 and EXPOSE 8080.

FILES CREATED:
- container/app.py: stdlib-only (http.server ThreadingHTTPServer), no external deps. Routes GET / (and /health) -> health 'ok'; GET /order -> echoes a sample order with points; POST /order -> echoes posted order with points (400 on malformed/non-object body). Listens on 0.0.0.0:PORT.
- container/requirements.txt: intentionally empty (stdlib-only) to keep the image small.
- container/Dockerfile: FROM python:3.12-slim, WORKDIR /app, COPY requirements.txt + app.py, ENV PORT=8080, EXPOSE 8080, CMD ["python","app.py"]. No network-dependent build step.

LOYALTY RULE: points = floor(order.total) * POINTS_PER_DOLLAR (env, default 10) — matches the FEAT-002 Lambda handler. ORDERS_QUEUE_URL / ORDERS_TABLE_NAME env from taskdef are available but not required by the minimal HTTP demo app.

NOTE: container/taskdef.json already existed (created by FEAT-002); not modified. Did not read/import from applications or demo/session3; did not run docker build/push.
